reason: The historical death gloss claims loss of all bodily attributes as well as necessary functions; bodies retain attributes after death, so this overstates a biological definition.
The subtract gloss only says make a subtraction; it repeats the nominal derivative without explaining the arithmetic operation.
The stimulate gloss only says act as a stimulant; its derivative is circular and does not explain the intended sense.
The divide gloss only says perform a division; it does not define the arithmetic operation independently of a nominal derivative.
The multiply gloss only says combine by multiplication; it substitutes a nominal derivative for an explanation of the operation.
The idle gloss repeats be idle and describes a changeless situation; inactivity is not changelessness and this gloss does not explain the human activity sense.
The attach gloss only says cause to be attached; it is a circular passive restatement without an independent definition.
The precede gloss only says be the predecessor of, substituting a derived noun without explaining the temporal or office succession relationship.
The succeed gloss only says be the successor (of), substituting a derived noun without explaining the office succession relationship.
The continue gloss repeats continue a certain state, condition, or activity without independently defining continuation.
The open gloss only says cause to open or to become open; both formulations repeat the lemma without explaining the physical action.
The drop out gloss contains the malformed phrase defeat of lacking hope and restricts withdrawal to defeat or hopelessness; preserve neither a source typo nor a misleading restriction.
The win gloss repeats win something through ones efforts; it adds a circumstance without explaining the acquisition sense.
The synthesize gloss contains the malformed phrase more complex, product; remove the historical source error rather than silently rewriting a verbatim definition.
The engine idle gloss repeats idle and calls it run disconnected; idling engines are still running, and the gloss neither explains their unloaded operation nor supports the emitted idle/run contrast.
Forfeiting a right and asserting a claim are not lexical opposites in the displayed senses: a forfeited claim can still be asserted, and claiming is not retaining or acquiring the right.
The uncover sense specifically exposes a body by removing clothing, while cover is unrestricted placement of a covering; the displayed pair mixes scopes rather than giving matched opposed senses.

The bring gloss describes fetching or returning an object, whereas take away describes removal to another place or state; fetching can itself take an object away, so these exact senses are not complementary.
Riding and walking are alternative modes of travel, not antonyms; other modes are possible and absence of one does not indicate its supposed opposite.
Suffer is glossed as undergo or be subjected to, without adverse experience; one can both undergo and benefit from an event, so this pair does not establish the emitted positive/negative contrast.
Granting an exemption and ensuring observance of rules can coexist; enforcing a rule may include enforcing its exemptions. These unrestricted displayed senses do not form a reliable antonym pair.
